QuestInfo.name: A Missing Friend
QuestInfo.0: #p2151002# wants to talk to you. This might be about\r\nthe #b#t4033666##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2151002# wants you to take the #b#t4033666##k to\r\n#b#p2151003##k. #p2151003# seems to be worried about\r\n#p2151002#.
QuestInfo.2: #p2151003# revealed how she felt. She just wants her friend back.

yes.0: If #b#p2151003##k seems depressed after looking at that photo, then... Eh, forget it. I hate making dumb speculations.
yes.1: Just take it to her! I'll deal with her if she gets all grumpy on you.

no.0: Aren't you worried about #p2151003#? Y-you... forget it. I don't care!

1.0: What is it, #b#h0##k?\r\n#L0##b#p2151002# wanted me to give you this. To cheer you up.#l\n#k
1.1: This photo... I used to know this child. It was days before the Black Wings came, before they began to take people...\r\n#L0##bWho is your friend?#l\n#k
1.2: Back in the lab, you asked me where I got the dagger. It belonged to my friend. We were playing one day and I asked if I could see it. I was going to make a nice sheath, but the Black Wings... I held on to it, hoping to return it one day.\r\n#L0##bI want to ask you something, #p2151003#.#l\n#k
1.3: What is it?\r\n#L0##bWhat if your friend came back?#l\n#k
1.4: I'd like that very much.\r\n#L0##bEven if your friend was a completely different person?#l\n#k
1.5: I...\r\n#L0##bWhat if everything is different now?#l\n#k
1.6: I-It doesn't matter to me. Everything changes, even this town, but we make do with what we have. I know my friend was a good person, and that's all that matters to me.

yes.0: As much as I'd love for things to go back to the way they were, everything's different now, and that's okay. I'll fight for the city and the people I love.

npc.0: What was #bClaudine#k up to? Uh, you DO know where she is right? She's at the center of the Secret Plaza.
